item.title: A Pokémon of a Different Color
The Dark Side of the Enlightenment
item.description:
📝 The violence that Crais – a distinguished historian of Africa – has chosen to examine is the extractive violence of market capitalism, which is what enabled industrialisation in the West. To his credit, Crais acknowledges that “it would be myopic to imagine that life didn’t improve for millions (later billions) of people because of the Industrial Revolution”. Today there are more than ten times that number.
🔗 Read more: https://www.newstatesman.com/culture/books/2026/02/the-dark-side-of-the-enlightenment
